common_mistakes.problem: Assuming the happy-path output proves all inputs are safe.
common_mistakes.why: Empty, malformed, boundary, or concurrent cases may follow different paths.
common_mistakes.fix: Add focused tests for a normal input and at least one relevant edge case.

common_mistakes.problem: Ignoring returned errors or external-system status.
common_mistakes.why: Go APIs commonly report expected failures as explicit error values.
common_mistakes.fix: Check errors close to the operation, add useful context when propagating, and clean up resources.

common_mistakes.problem: Using an API or syntax without checking the selected Go version.
common_mistakes.why: Language and standard-library capabilities can change between releases.
common_mistakes.fix: Record `go version`, inspect the `go` directive, and read official release notes for version-specific topics.
